correctness.rationale: Explicit nodal reproducing functions satisfy all mass-matrix pairings. The beta-marginal absolute-integral identity is derived by direct integration. Convex barycentric decomposition proves nodal domination of every kernel row. The exact derivative of N_d is strictly negative on (0,1), yielding both extrema and strict nonattainment; dimensions d>=2 and positive simplex volumes are maintained throughout. The distributed checker independently passed 432 exact rational nodal comparisons and 54 whole-norm comparisons.

evidence: The 1987 stability article is publicly described as Lp/W1p boundedness under mesh restrictions, with no visible numerical sharp endpoint constant.

Karkulik–Pavlicek–Praetorius prove an H1 estimate for adaptive 2D meshes, whose constant depends on shape regularity; their Theorem 6 is not a formula for unrestricted two-simplex L-infinity amplification.
Bramble–Pasciak–Steinbach is H1 stability under local mesh conditions.

value.rationale: Two facet-adjacent simplices form the minimal higher-dimensional conforming patch in which the L2 finite-element projector couples distinct element masses. The exact norm and optimizing area balance quantify mesh-grading amplification with a shape-independent constant for all d>=2. The sharp planar range from 49/18 to unattained 7/2 and universal d-dimensional degeneration laws are useful local stability benchmarks, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
